notes.title: A-Tech Cybernetic Update - Index Controller support & complete 'Swarm' overhaul!
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone, [/b]

A-Tech Cybernetic’s full release is getting closer and closer - this update is probably one of the last steps before we consider the game finished. 

[h2]INDEX CONTROLLER SUPPORT[/h2]

We have added proper Index Controller support [i](finger tracking not included)[/i]. We've tried to make the most comfortable and practical layout possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28133510/f3bcaded30e88fb015f1c48cebc8b4401c3bac1c.jpg[/img]

[h2]SWARM MODE OVERHAUL[/h2]

We have also [b]completely overhauled the 'Swarm' mode[/b] of the game. We took extreme care while [b]rebalancing each wave[/b] - as a result, the difficulty curve now increases gradually and makes playing 'Swarm' more challenging, and more rewarding. 

[b]We have also added a new level: 'Reactor'[/b] - and removed one: 'Cave'. 
The 'Cave' level wasn't up to our optimization and quality standards, it would've taken more time to fix it than to add a completely new one, so we went with the latter option. 

Another [b]new balancing feature[/b] is the way weapons unlock - they now become available in a [b]pre-defined order[/b] in every wave.
[b]Weapon spawning has also changed[/b] - on easy, normal and hard difficulties, picked-up weapons respawn after 10, 15 and 30 seconds respectively.

These changes mean that the 'Swarm' mode as a whole became more balanced, but more challenging at the same time. 
[i]Giving it another shot is recommended even for seasoned A-Tech players! :)[/i]

[h2]ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCK SYSTEM[/h2]

We've fixed the achievement unlock system, every achievement should now count correctly and should work as intended overall. 

---

That's all for now. If you encounter any issues, please let us know either below this post, in the community hub or via Discord. 
We see everything, even if we don't respond immediately. :) 

Thank you guys for your continuous support! 
[i]-XREAL Games Team-[/i]

notes.title: A-Tech Cybernetic Content Update - Two new Chapters, fixes & improvements!
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone, [/b]

This is it.. The long awaited content update is here!
The [b] two brand new Chapters, Chapter 05 - The Sundering and Chapter 06 - The End [/b] brings an epic closure to A-Tech Cybernetic’s story. 
We’ve overhauled the gameplay and combat intensity throughout the whole game - in return, it became much more challenging! [i] You really have to break a sweat in order to survive each Chapter. [/i]

Besides adding new content, we’ve fixed countless community-reported issues and made improvements on all aspects of the game. 
You can check all the fixes and improvements in the patch notes below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28133510/f06d687d37d213146934a2af93be88f95d170d54.jpg[/img]

[h1]GENERAL AI FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved Brute behavior.
[*] [b]Improved accuracy and behavior[/b] for armed enemies - [i] as a result, the game became a tiiiny bit more difficult. [/i]
[*] Various other fixes for armed enemies.
[*] Fixed a crash caused by zombies exploding.
[*] Fixed an issue with enemies changing colour before dissolving.
[*] General improvement of enemy performance and behavior.
[*] Polished enemy animations.
[/list]

[h1]GAMEPLAY RELATED FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved accessibility: a [b]left-handed control layout[/b] has been added.
[*] Improved locomotion.
[*] Vive controller teleport fix: in turning mode, teleport is only activated by hitting UP on the touchpad. No more accidental teleporting while turning.
[*] Fixed a rare bug where the player could’ve gotten stuck when dying during hand scanning.
[*] Fixed the menu laser pointer.
[*] Revised checkpoints.
[*] New safety timers for objective triggers.
[*] Fixed teleports.
[*] Updated enemy encounters.
[*] Fixed an issue where the detonator didn’t disappear after the explosion.
[*] Improved navigation.
[*] Fixed a locomotion issue when playing while sitting down, or being really short.
[*] Fixed tutorial controllers not attaching to the player’s hand properly on the menu level.
[*] Temporary fix for players not being able to pick up weapon ammo during later chapters [i](if they skipped previous chapters) [/i]
[*] The flashlight can not be dropped accidentally.
[*] Melee weapons can be stored (one at a time).
[*] Fixed flamethrower.
[*] Fixed ladder static component.
[*] Weapon projectiles are now unaffected by gravity.
[*] General sound mix balance update.
[*] Updated objective markers.
[*] Updated chapter 2 “hangar fight” enemy encounter.
[/list]

[h1]PERFORMANCE OPTIMIZATION[/h1]
[list]
[*] Various skeletal meshes have been converted to static meshes.
[*] Fixed memory leak issue in Chapter 03: unused particles are removed.
[*] Updated level streaming.
[*] Added splash screen and credit roll.
[/list]

[h1] KNOWN ISSUES [/h1]
[list]
[*] Achievements are WiP, might not be unlocking correctly, or at all. 
[*] The “turn music off” option is not yet implemented in the menus.
[*] There is a rare issue with HTC Vive headset audio output that might cause crashes. If this happens, connect your ear/headphones directly to the PC and set your audio device to the PC audio output port instead of the Vive.
[*] Swarm mode is under development, will be reworked in the next update.
[/list]
--- 

That’s all for now. 
This update is an important step towards the game’s[b] Full Release this year[/b], so if you encounter any issues, or just want to share your feedback with us, please head over to the game’s [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/578210/discussions/]community hub[/url], or to our [url=https://discord.gg/R5ZUsjB]Discord server[/url]. 
[i] We read everything, even if we don’t respond. :) [/i]

Thank you for the continuous support!
[i]XREAL Games Team[/i]

notes.title: A-Tech Cybernetic devblog - Breaking the silence: new update coming soon™!
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone, [/b]

Long time no see! 
In this news post i will shed some light on A-Tech Cybernetic's development and the content of the long awaited, upcoming update. [i]You can check the preliminary patch notes at the end of this post. [/i]

3 years ago, our small indie team consisting of talented VR enthusiasts started working on A-Tech Cybernetic. As it was the team's first VR project, one could say that this was also a learning project. But an ambitious one at that. 
The development went great, the team started growing and another project emerged from our developer's minds. 

A team within the team started working on the new project, while the original A-Tech team continued the game's development. 
Around this time last year, the team went further and dreamt bigger: why lock the game to PC and leave other platforms out of the fun? 
And so happened that we've started exploring yet another completely unknown realm: PSVR. 
We knew porting it was going to be difficult, but started it anyway because at the time we could easily manage a parallel development. [i]Or so we thought.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28133510/5115f543b17898ad2cbf402e6a23859da26511df.jpg[/img]

I've mentioned it a few times that in order to have a successfull port, we had to develop both versions simultaneously (or even from scratch).

Long story short, technical difficulties arose (quite a few) which meant that we had to delay the PC version's update further and further. 
We know this isn't how it should've happened, and we apologize for that. It was a valuable lesson for XREAL Games, all our current and future endevours will benefit from our experiences. :)

[b]And now, for the update itself.[/b] A ton of things will be fixed/optimized, left handed support is coming, as are two brand new Chapters: [b]05 - The Sundering[/b] and [b]06 - The End[/b], the latter bringing the story to a closure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28133510/f2d83028f8fbad899c9062a4f8ee252c26c6d09b.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Improved Brute behavior.
[*] Improved accuracy and behavior for armed enemies.
[*] Various other fixes for armed enemies.
[*] Fixed a crash caused by zombies exploding.

[*] Polished enemy animations.
[/list]

[h1]GAMEPLAY RELATED IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]

[*] Improved accessibility: a [b]left-handed control layout[/b] has been added.
[*] Improved locomotion.
[*] Menu laser pointer fix.
[*] Revised checkpoints.
[*] New safety timers for objective triggers.
[*] Fixed teleports.
[*] Updated enemy encounters.
[*] Improved navigation.
[*] The flashlight can not be dropped accidentally.
[*] Melee weapons can be stored (one at a time).
[*] Fixed flamethrower.
[*] Fixed ladder static component.

[/list]

[h1]PERFORMANCE OPTIMIZATION[/h1]

[/list]

--- 

The full patch notes will accompany the update itself. We'd really love to release it [b]before the end of October in preparation of the game's full release later this year[/b], but keep an eye out on this post's comment section, if anything happens i'll keep you all updated there. 

We're soon launching a devlog series on our [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCj9kaf9i-FT-RkUPPLTh-dg]Youtube channel[/url], so if you'd like to stay up to date with our projects and our team, consider subscribing. :)
You can also hop on our [url=https://discord.gg/R5ZUsjB]Discord server[/url] to get in touch with the developers.

Once again sorry for the silence, and thank you for your patience and continuous support!

notes.title: What's up with A-Tech Cybernetic VR?
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hey guys! [/b][/h1]

We owe you an apology and an explanation about A-Tech Cybernetic VR. You might’ve noticed that there were no updates since last year. 
We have also got some questions recently whether the game has been abandoned.
[b]Fear not, the game isn’t abandoned![/b] 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/d93667b4236d97e6547c701cd76341647f6b44fa.jpg[/img]

That's right! We’re working on the story’s conclusion in the background, but… we’ve decided to share our project with yet another VR community: [b]PSVR[/b] users. 
In order to meet Sony’s requirements, we had to go back to the game’s roots, and work through the code and visuals almost from scratch. 

[h1]What does this mean?[/h1]

It means that we have to [b]develop [/b]the PC version [b]in conjunction[/b] with the PSVR version. For a small indie studio like us, it is a [b]huge task[/b] as we had no previous experience with PSVR. This unfortunately slowed down the development process quite a bit, but it is something we wanted to do, even if it seemed impossible at the beginning. 

We’re also experimenting with a[b] different rendering technique[/b] to make the game as sharp as possible. It requires a lot of testing and optimization, but we hope the final results will be worth it. :)

[b]Once again, we’re sorry for the lack of updates and information, we didn’t want to confirm anything prematurely. [/b]
We’ll keep you updated, we aren’t that far from the game’s full release! 

Thank you all for your patience! 
[i]XREAL Games Team
[/i]

notes.title: A-Tech Cybernetic VR: what’s next?
notes.content:
[b] Hey guys and gals! [/b]

Our last story update’s [“Chapter 04: The Surface”] reception was absolutely amazing, we’re glad you guys liked it!

[h1] [b] Brace yourselves, Chapter 05: The Sundering is coming! [/b] [/h1] 

Currently we’re working on the story’s next chapter. It picks up right from where Chapter 04 left off. Tough decisions are ahead, which may or may not make things worse for our main character. ;) 
Here’s two, very work in progress screenshots, the environment will one up Chapter 04’s astonishing outside aesthetics! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/749855320dd82126909153e25596cd326edd9ea1.png[/img] [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/5bcf7376a1f933edd306907b4b4df1310e21dd5e.png[/img]

[b] New enemy, new weapons [/b] 

Our family of life threatening mutants will be expanded by a new foe. Sharpen your sight! Thanks to its cloaking mechanism, our new friend will be able to blend in its surroundings, surprising you when you least expect it! 

To counter enemies more effectively, we’ll include a new, Uzi-type machine gun and a flamethrower. [i] If it bleeds, you can kill it! [/i] Especially with your new toys. 

[b] New tutorial [/b]

To make sure you don’t get lost in the maze of VR controls, we’ll also add a new, fun tutorial. Hopefully it will be as intuitive as possible and it will teach you everything you need to know in order to survive. It will also explain the story better. 

[b] We’ve also put together a new, action packed Story trailer for your eyes and ears to feast upon! [/b] 

You can check it here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lNtasi1I7FE

[i] Join our Discord server to get exclusive behind the scenes info and chat with us directly! We’d like to see your opinion and ideas. [/i] https://discord.gg/R5ZUsjB

notes.title: Dev Diary 4. - Chapter 4.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/ef24b20499a372269e7245b188e08ab58ab4dd55.png[/img]

[h1]Hello there![/h1] (...General Kenobi!) 

It's Makrangoncias again. Today’s post is about Chapter 4. Working Title: “Surface”

[b]Chapter 4 is coming in a few weeks[/b] and it's kind of a big deal for us. It’s the first level designed from scratch since the original 3, and boy can you feel the difference! The explorable area is roughly the same as chapter 1-2 COMBINED (maybe even bigger), the scales are off the chart, and [b]everything is just huge[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/ba1e8dafa5cafce909e8275daa3e8ab23bf18d4f.png[/img]
[i]Yep, that's a full-scale dump truck.[/i]
 
What made this easier to achieve is that this is a [b]completely outdoor level[/b], so we could utilize the “landscape” tool of Unreal, basically sculpting out the layout of the level instead of placing a ton of cubes. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/ed69dc65d688cb50b76353761fbd7ff06efe9f40.png[/img]
[i]Our next IP: Clay-Tech Cybernetic[/i]

What we were worried about though is that the size and outdoor nature of the level might affect performance. [b]About performance:[/b] Vr-ready machines are basically the strongest PC-s commercially available on this planet, yet we still have to optimize the game as strictly as we would for a 5-8 year old hardware. Why? Because in VR games instead of just one, you have a total of 3 displays (2 for your eyes, and 1 for your desktop monitor). Each of them running around Full HD resolution (higher for the Vive Pro) and the two in your headset require at least 90fps. So it’s actually worse than rendering the game for three standard monitors, and that consumes a hell lot of hardware capacity.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/d40258821973aebfb2eea46dd1f05da8140cbbff.jpg[/img]
[i]Even a Titan starts to sweat under VR[/i]

But enough of the technicalities. The reason why most VR games play in very confined or at least well-separated areas is that these require much less resources to optimize. Nevertheless, we’ve tried implementing a [b]truly massive, continuous map layout[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/e9d95bc6987be82a37e7f183e8c6fa5aef485d05.png[/img]
[i]That circled area is the same size as the area of the hangar fight.[/i]

To our huge but pleasant suprise, the [b]performance seems to be stable[/b]. What’s more it’s even more stable than on the usual indoor levels, so much so that we even managed to add some fancy new effects! Last but not least, the great render distance made is possible to utilize the [b]new Sniper Rifle[/b], and using it is a ton of fun. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/065bc099904ac803be437bdc653f3f374454d930.png[/img]
[i]A true beast for a wild map[/i]

From a design and gameplay perspective, [b]Chapter 4 is a huge leap forward[/b], but like everything else, it also comes with a price. We had to save time by avoiding events that require custom behavior, but I think the new environment, the sniper rifle and all the fresh gameplay that they bring will be more than enough to keep you entertained! We're crazy anxious about your feedback, you can expect Ch4 in the next few weeks!

[b]Norbert (Makrangoncias)[/b]
Game and Level designer

notes.title: UPDATE - Story Mode Chapter 02 - 2017.12.14.
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/a01d861647122fbf956129993fa4856746c0077a.jpg[/img]

We also made a couple other improvements & fixes, here’s the full changelog:

Updates to [b] A-Tech Cybernetic[/b] have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client (in on-line mode) is restarted.

[b]These changes affect the Early Access game and the Free Demo build too.[/b]

[b]Watch Our Chapter 02 Trailer on our Youtube Channel: [/b]
https://youtu.be/g9kiFv_BJ9w

[b]Update v0.8.4.3[/b]

[b]Sorry for the long silence, we grabbed a little more than we could handle at the time. But here’s the list: [/b]

[list]
[*]Complete narration overhaul
[*]Complete Zombie AI and animation overhaul
[*]Melee overhaul
[*]A new chapter of adventures
[*]Swarm mode updates
[*]Literally thousands of bugs fixed (and several dozen more bugs features generated as side effect) 
[*]Even more linear gameplay (we never thought that this might be a good thing) 
[*]Optimization tweaks, the game should even run below the minimal hardware
[*]Additional sounds in many places
[*]Graphics improvement all around
[*]Checkpoint system, save and load options
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/2d43e1f217330110fd3121aa3c2055272a0a018a.jpg[/img]

[b]Details[/b]

[h1][b]Chapter 1[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]We completely ditched the previous narrative, both the voice acting and the story. Yaaaay. [strike](Sorry guys who actually liked it)[/strike].Now it contains strong language, so faint hearted beware! 
[*]Removed the “flashback” scene. It made no sense.
[*]Added a new introduction period where you gradually get access to the features of the game. 
[*]Added some hand-holding to the first corridor (“what the hell am I supposed to do”) 
[*]Serious (according to our GFX team, go see for yourself) graphical improvements to the main chamber.
[*]Overall removed every obstacle from the main path, you can play using only locomotion (some areas are still only accessible with teleport but they aren’t needed for the story) 
[*]Removed many “where the f.ck did these come from” moments 
[*]No more facetearing maniacs running from the rooms that merge with your body because they are so fast. 
[*]Somewhat improved loot, more HP in the later stages of the map. (and overall more LEWT) 
[*]Improved pathing and corridor layout (You won’t stuck on everything, maybe only on every 2nd or 3rd object. 
[*]The Network (the matrix-thingy) drops you out automatically after completing the task. Which is now much more obvious. 
[*]Object clipping, like lights and fires is fixed 

[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/723215a1ba7c33c3c86cc04d8768444e2f50437b.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Chapter 2[/b][/h1]
It’s finally implemented. We won’t go into details because explore it for yourself, but we can tell you it was seriously reworked based on your feedback. When you find ways to break it please message us and we will include your name in the next patch notes (Eternal fame, infinite money etc. might come with it).

[h1] [b]Enemies [/b] [/h1]
[list]
[*]A massive all around rework. Basically everything changed. 
Noticeably stronger enemies. Much more HP and damage (even if you play on “tea party” difficulty you might notice it).
[*]Body shots do way less damage than headshots. 
[*]Their animations are more responsive, they react if you hit them. 
[*]Improved AI and overall behavior (no more running in one place) 
[*]Sometimes sneaking is an option (to a certain degree) 
[*]Melee improvements. You have to hit them properly to do damage, melee weapons are OP AF. You might throw the enemies across the room with a proper hit. But if you let them come close, you can get overwhelmed in mere seconds. High risk, high reward. 
If you just b.tchslap them they might collapse but they will get back up and get revenge for the offense. 
Brute (the big chubby guy) is much more durable now, acts like the tank he is. 
[*]The shooter enemy is much more dangerous now, take cover. 
[*]The fast enemy is tearing you to pieces in a few seconds. 
[*]New teleport effect on the teleporting enemy

[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/2d41bf8d93ba5f4d5561c9c30e0d541942e538f7.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Objects[/b] [/h1]
[list]
[*]Fire now damages properly and much deadlier now
[*]HP station recharge is gradual and the total amount is increased
[*]HP pickup health restore reduced from 50 to 20
[*]Armor pickup armor given reduced from 50 to 25
[*]Door opening panels are now much more consistent in both behavior and visuals
[*]Multiple objects received new interaction sound
[*]Force pull is now twice as fast
[*]Keycards open the door consistently
[*]Everything gameplay related (crates, drawers etc.)  is now colored yellow, and has a distinctive lighting method
[*]Everything that is not related and was yellow before was recolored to grey

[/list]


[h1]On the Store page, you'll find the Download Demo button here (scrolling down, in the right sidebar):[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/ca617f85f589672676891cbd32f9e294f00723f8.jpg[/img]

[b]Let the feedback flow in again, we’re counting on you to tell us if it’s pure gold or real shit what we’ve just made - or something in between[/b]

notes.title: UPDATE - Story Mode and Swarm Mode - 2017.10.08
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/85dff3418d942e44c73cb4ad471308ae3be39308.jpg[/img]

[i]Updates to [b]A-Tech Cybernetic[/b] have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client (in on-line mode) is restarted.[/i]

[b]These changes affect the Early Access game and the Free Demo build too.[/b]

[h1]General fixes & updates[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved the Menu Tutorial (ingame tutorial will also be reworked, but in a later update)
[*]Graphics optimizations
[*]Fixed the blurry issue by improving Anti-aliasing - added a screen percentage slider (~SS slider) to the options -  now the game has more clear visuals
[*]Meelee weapons and flashlight can now be holstered
[*]Improved UI - you’ll get more information now from the UI
[/list]

[h1]Story Mode specific fixes & updates[/h1]
[list]
[*]A narrative cutscene is now added to the beginning of Story Mode Chapter 01
[*]There’s more loot to find now in Story Mode Chapter 01
[*]Navigation (locomotion) improvements - now you can move more smoothly without getting stuck at places
[*]Graphical fixes on the door opening panels
[*]Added more directional texts to make it easier to find your way
[*]Interactive items / gameplay elements are now marked with green to be more noticable
[*]Flashlight light/shadows fixed on every quality level (there were issues with the flashlight not working on medium quality level before)
[*]Optimizations in level streaming
[*]Swinging melee weapons properly now deals more damage than just barely moving your hands - no more cat-fights :)
[*]More precise weapon realoading (when overlapping with holster)
[*]Force pull improvements (can't force pull from holster, can force pull through holstered weapons)
[*]Interactive elements can now be grabbed/pulled with trigger
[*]Added subtitles background for easier readability
[*]Other minor bugfixes
[/list]
[b]More Story Mode updates will follow continuously - stay tuned :)[/b]


[h1]Guns blazing update for the Swarm Mode ;)[/h1]
[list]
[*]Did you find the swarm mode meh? Bang, bang, bang and everyone dead? NO MORE!
[*]Spawn system reworked! Even on easier difficulties, you get to be overwhelmed easily if you don’t pay attention. On Nightmare, it literally is nightmare. Prepare your a… khmm, prepare yourself!
[*]Weapons buffed! You get to fire away like crazy now. Weapon mags are increased by 30-100% so you no longer need to worry about reloading. Speaking of which:
[*]Wepxplosions!  Some of you missed reloading in swarm mode, and felt sorry for their beloved instrument of death once it run dry. Stop it now! Throw your empty weapons into the mutant’s faces and watch them explode into bloody chunks. Delightful, isn’t it?
[*]Weapon spawn times drastically reduced! Combine this with the previous points and calculate the ridiculous amount of bullets flying with explosions in the background.
[*]Map reworks! Missed strategic layouts on the maps, hated running around? Now you can hate running around without missing anything! Teleport over obstacles, laugh at the stupid mutants while they try to get around before you shoot them to pieces!
[*]Pickup spawners! Bad news for haters, running around and collecting health, armor and bullet time actually makes sense now! Stay alive longer or get yourself into horribly bad situations while trying to survive!
[*]Music! It’s such a big deal, huh? Nah, it isn’t. But we finally worked it out!
[*]Hidden stuff and loot! Look around carefully and you can find some free guns laying around. MOOOAR BULLETS AND EXPLOSIONS!
[*]Reduced wait times between waves! You don’t need that much time to take a few guns, don’t you?
[*]Removed barrel-placement phase! We don’t even know why was it in the game at all. Barrels now spawn automatically, eager to blow your enemies up. Or you. They don’t really care, believe me.
[*]Somewhat improved enemy AI. Yes, they are still not the smartest guys on Earth, but well, what do you expect from some mutants who are the result of a science experiment gone awry?
[/list]
[b]More maps and improvements coming soon, stay tuned![/b]

We're counting on your continued feedback! Keep it coming :)

[*]Force pull improvements (can't force pull from holster, can force pull through holstered weapons)
[*]Interactive elements can now be grabbed/pulled with trigger
[*]Added subtitles background for easier readability
[*]Other minor bugfixes
[/list]
[b]More Story Mode updates will follow continuously - stay tuned :)[/b]


[h1]Guns blazing update for the Swarm Mode ;)[/h1]
[list]
[*]Did you find the swarm mode meh? Bang, bang, bang and everyone dead? NO MORE!
[*]Spawn system reworked! Even on easier difficulties, you get to be overwhelmed easily if you don’t pay attention. On Nightmare, it literally is nightmare. Prepare your a… khmm, prepare yourself!
[*]Weapons buffed! You get to fire away like crazy now. Weapon mags are increased by 30-100% so you no longer need to worry about reloading. Speaking of which:
[*]Wepxplosions!  Some of you missed reloading in swarm mode, and felt sorry for their beloved instrument of death once it run dry. Stop it now! Throw your empty weapons into the mutant’s faces and watch them explode into bloody chunks. Delightful, isn’t it?
[*]Weapon spawn times drastically reduced! Combine this with the previous points and calculate the ridiculous amount of bullets flying with explosions in the background.
[*]Map reworks! Missed strategic layouts on the maps, hated running around? Now you can hate running around without missing anything! Teleport over obstacles, laugh at the stupid mutants while they try to get around before you shoot them to pieces!
[*]Pickup spawners! Bad news for haters, running around and collecting health, armor and bullet time actually makes sense now! Stay alive longer or get yourself into horribly bad situations while trying to survive!
[*]Music! It’s such a big deal, huh? Nah, it isn’t. But we finally worked it out!
[*]Hidden stuff and loot! Look around carefully and you can find some free guns laying around. MOOOAR BULLETS AND EXPLOSIONS!
[*]Reduced wait times between waves! You don’t need that much time to take a few guns, don’t you?
[*]Removed barrel-placement phase! We don’t even know why was it in the game at all. Barrels now spawn automatically, eager to blow your enemies up. Or you. They don’t really care, believe me.
[*]Somewhat improved enemy AI. Yes, they are still not the smartest guys on Earth, but well, what do you expect from some mutants who are the result of a science experiment gone awry?
[/list]
[b]More maps and improvements coming soon, stay tuned![/b]

We're counting on your continued feedback! Keep it coming :)

notes.title: UPDATE #6 - New Map, Bossfight, Swarm Mode Changes
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=edoJwEp1wJE

[b] A-Tech Cybernetic has reached a new milestone! [/b]

Swarm mode has been enlarged with a brand-new map the most exciting, spectacular and fearful 'Cave'.

The new map would mean nothing with just the ordinary stuff. Along with the new visuals a new boss has also arrived: the Brute.

What is more different lighting scenarios were added for every difficulty level to let you feel the stakes of your actions!

The dynamics of the game has leveled up with the appearance of a new ’weapons for points’ mechanism. You can't just take a gun off the walls anymore but with having to count all your in-game points, you have to be more tactical. You have to pay more attention to all the details!

All the doors can be locked now, so don’t forget to take advantage of this new feature to get some breathing space (and some valuable points) in the aciton packed thriller! 


Highlights:
- New level: Cave
- New enemy: Brute (boss-type)
- Money system (get for killing, spend for guns)
- Closable zombie doors
- Gamedesign became more colorful, more balanced
- Optimizations
 
Minor additions:
- A lot of bugfixes
- Enemy animations improved
- More distinct difficulty levels (with different light scenarios)
- Game state messages
- Tutorials expanded
- Graphical tweaks, new effects added
